facts: The published rgb and depth data share the viewpoint of the right RGB camera.
The published imu.txt belongs to that right RGB camera and has ROS topic /uvc_camera/cam_2/imu.
The other published IMU files belong to the left RGB and two infrared cameras, so they are not the rgb/depth viewpoint IMU.
A camchain YAML stores each camera as a separate camera node.
Each camera node carries the rostopic of that camera image stream.
T_cam_imu is attached to a camera node and transforms IMU coordinates into that camera's coordinates.

selection_contract.selection_operator: Across every bounded YAML candidate, retain every valid camera-node T_cam_imu discovery, then require exactly one discovery whose same-node rostopic namespace equals /uvc_camera/cam_2.

claim_ceiling: This evidence freezes an official sensor-namespace selection rule only. It does not inspect the local calibration archive, prove a matching node exists, or authorize an R1 execution.
